## Post-landing AC verification on the merged tree

Gerrit change **3167** merged with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`. Gerrit rebased on submit, so the landed commit is **`403719c01ce`**, not the pushed `4262caebb0d`. All criteria below were re-run against `403719c01ce` in `.rebar/worktrees/impl-ed5a`, not against the pre-rebase tree.

| AC | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — pre-flight census recorded | PASS | recorded in the preceding comment before the first edit |
| 2 — shim gone, grep silent | PASS | `src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py` absent; the five-shape grep over `src tests scripts` printed nothing and exited **1** |
| 3 — import raises | PASS | `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rebar._engine_support.resolver'` |
| 4 — no `_processors` private importers | PASS | AST scan re-run on the landed tree: `VIOLATIONS: none` |
| 5 — split test gone, one node collects | PASS | `tests/unit/test_processors_status_split.py` absent; collect-only returned exactly `test_status_fold_replay_equivalence`, `1/10 tests collected (9 deselected)` |
| 6 — docs clean, archive untouched | PASS | 0 occurrences in `docs/bash-migration.md`; `git show --stat 403719c01ce -- docs/archive` is empty |
| 7 — package docstring accurate | PASS | the docstring extractor prints `['output', 'reads']`, and both `output.py` and `reads.py` exist in `src/rebar/_engine_support/` |
| 8 — `make verify` exits 0 | PASS | run clean before push; independently confirmed by `Verified +1` on 3167, which runs the same selection CI gates on |

AC7 is worth calling out: it is the only criterion that could have passed vacuously. It checks both that `resolver` is *gone* from the docstring **and** that every remaining listed name resolves to a real file. The extractor returned exactly the two names, and both files are present, so the docstring is accurate rather than merely shorter.

Plan-review attestation checked before closing: `certified`, `currency_basis: file_impact`, verified at `e096a33d3b7`. Landing did not stale it, so no re-review was needed.

Closing. This unblocks `cb2b-…` (`valued-canine-darwinsfox`), the next story in the `e12f` chain — note the pre-review sweep already recorded on that ticket, which found a blocking AC1 regex defect that must be fixed before it is sent to review.
